errors.evidence: The chart clearly shows seven distinct slices, not six.
The slice representing 1.1% is labeled "Mix-Sound-Music" in the figure, not "Mix-Sound-Speech".
The slice representing 2.4% is labeled "Mix-Sound-Music-Speech" in the figure, not "Mix-Sound-Music".
The slice representing 8.2% is labeled "Mix-Music-Speech" in the figure, not "Mix-Sound-Speech".
The description fails to mention that the chart is a donut chart (a pie chart with a hole in the center), not a standard pie chart.
